requirements.title: Software Design and Development
requirements.description: Collaborate with product managers and other developers to design, build, and deploy new software programs and features.
requirements.explanation: The candidate has demonstrated experience in designing and developing business intelligence applications using React and Python/Flask, directly aligning with the requirement to design, build, and deploy software.

requirements.title: Coding
requirements.description: Write clean, scalable, and efficient code using established development practices and conventions.
requirements.explanation: The candidate is proficient in JavaScript/React for frontend and Python/Flask for backend, indicating the ability to write clean, scalable, and efficient code.

requirements.title: Testing and Debugging
requirements.description: Conduct unit and integration testing and perform debugging to ensure strong functionality, optimal performance, and security.
requirements.explanation: The candidate has a proven track record of troubleshooting complex issues, including location filtering problems and RBAC system implementations, which aligns with the requirement for testing and debugging.

requirements.title: Maintenance and Improvement
requirements.description: Maintain and improve the performance of existing software.
requirements.explanation: The candidate has experience in maintaining and improving business intelligence applications, which meets the requirement for software maintenance and improvement.

wishes.title: Collaborative Skills
wishes.description: Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions.
wishes.explanation: The candidate describes effective collaboration with cross-functional teams in their projects, demonstrating strong collaborative skills.

wishes.title: Creativity
wishes.explanation: The candidate has shown creativity in solving complex data visualization issues and implementing secure software architecture, although more specific examples of creativity could strengthen this match.
